goal: Close the approved-mission loop so an owner-approved A0-A2 Mission Control issue can automatically dispatch a bounded GitHub coding agent, surface runner status and return a PR for human review without browser credentials.
constraints: Agent must open a PR and may not merge/deploy/send/spend.
Runner failure must be visible rather than simulated.
done_when: A valid owner-approved A0-A2 issue reaches the dispatcher.
Dispatcher can create an idempotent target issue and request GitHub coding-agent assignment.
Mission Control snapshot/UI exposes compact runner status.
CI and public snapshot build pass.
uncertainties: GitHub Copilot cloud-agent assignment depends on the account/repository policy and an authenticated runner token; a post-merge dry-run must verify the token lane without spending an agent session.
next_step: Run Council syntax/tests/harness/public snapshot CI; if green, merge and execute a RUNNER_MODE dry-run preflight before enabling the first real approved mission.
